summary: fix(settings): Linked Accounts, device rows, mobile radius and hover tints for Nova
description:
Because:
- Design review asked for Nova device rows, rounded mobile cards, hover tints and a promo tint.
- Data Collection's "Learn more" links could wrap mid-phrase (flag-off fix).

This commit:
- Restyles device and linked-account rows under nova: per the designer's spec.
- Keeps section card radius on mobile and taller mobile UnitRow CTAs under nova:.
- Adds nova:-only bg-hover-tint and bg-promo-vibrant; applies them to closes and promos.
- Reverts nav external icons to today's size, 8px after the label under nova:.
- Keeps "Learn more" links on one line; uses font-heading on the header wordmark.
